mechanism.claim: Keep the frozen high-variation directional-change-scarcity and joint ticket-participation acceleration eligibility. Route with the confirmed eight-hour direction only when the final-hour range closes in that direction's outer quartile; otherwise route against it as terminal-auction rejection.
mechanism.side: confirmed long follows when final-hour close location>=0.75 and fades otherwise; confirmed short follows when final-hour close location<=0.25 and fades otherwise
mechanism.why_distinct: A frozen intrinsic-time scarcity plus ticket participation state is combined with a final-hour OHLC auction acceptance/rejection router; no outcome-fitted magnitude or promoted diagnostic control is used.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: coherent volatile paths with rising size and participation are separated by whether the terminal auction accepts the directional extreme or rejects it with an opposing wick
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: the underlying sparse HVDCSATPA clock passed Gross9 and close-location polarity changes exposure shape

features.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.directional_change_threshold: sqrt(mean(r_i squared)); strict positive and fixed for the completed block
features.state_machine: start unconfirmed at the first log close; confirm the first up/down state after a threshold move; thereafter count at most one reversal per minute when close retreats from the running high or rebounds from the running low by at least the fixed threshold
features.directional_change_count: integer reversal count after initial direction confirmation
features.directional_change_rank: strict-prior midrank of directional_change_count over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank<=0.25
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute close returns), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.block_return: log(last close/first open) over eight hours
features.late_return: log(last close/open at D-2h) over final two hours
features.direction_confirmation: block return and late return have one strict nonzero sign
features.ticket_source: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D), each with nonnegative quote_asset_volume and positive integer number_of_trades
features.half_average_tickets: sum quote_asset_volume divided by sum number_of_trades separately over [D-8h,D-4h) and [D-4h,D); both sums strict positive
features.joint_sponsorship_gate: both average_ticket_acceleration and trade_count_acceleration are strict positive; no fitted magnitude threshold
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact valid block ineligible; missing prior opportunity cannot trigger
features.final_hour_close_location: (last close - minimum low)/(maximum high - minimum low) over exact final 60 one-minute bars; strict positive range required
features.close_location_router: follow confirmed long at >=0.75 or confirmed short at <=0.25; otherwise fade; fixed quartiles

clock.side: final-hour close-location routed confirmed completed-return sign
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: causal intrinsic-time coherence, ticket participation sponsorship, and terminal-auction acceptance polarity

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no formula, threshold, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
